name: ticket-card
summary: A boarding pass or event ticket with real notches and a stub you can tear off.
props: Operator, venue or brand (and its logo), top-left.
Chip top-right ("VIP", "Business") — on holographic foil when holo.
Small line above the title or route ("Boarding pass · TP 1043").
Event name and details (omit for a route pass).
Route endpoints; a dashed flight path runs between them.
{ label: string; value: string; span?: number }[]
Details grid that wraps onto more rows; span widens a field.
Printed in the stub and shown big on the back. Omit for a ticket without a stub.
Look-alike code style — use renderCode for a scannable one.
Lines on the back: terms, baggage, gate notes.
Pass with the stub below, or admit-one ticket with the stub on the right.
Preset, or { fill, stub?, ink, soft?, accent, pattern? } — fill can be a gradient.
Route line, badge and stamp colour.
Rainbow foil glare and a holographic badge.
Rubber stamp across the ticket ("CHECKED IN"); thumps in when set.
Enables swiping the stub off along the tear line; called once it's gone.
Controlled torn state (the stub is gone, the torn edge stays).
Controlled or uncontrolled side (tap to flip).
Tilt toward the finger; false for long lists.
behavior: The card tilts toward your finger (tilt={false} turns it off). Tap to flip it to the big code and notes; with onTear set, swipe the stub sideways to tear it off.
A holo badge shimmers as the card leans, a stamp thumps down when set, and a torn stub falls away along the tear line.
A success notification when the stub tears off.
One element whose label joins the brand, title or route, every field and the stamp; it is a button when there is a back to flip to.
